contracts.detail: g_quark_to_string() runtime contract unchanged: declaration attribute changed from G_GNUC_CONST to G_GNUC_PURE. Before/after test comparison shows identical subtest counts and pass rates across 4 test suites (81 total subtests). gcov coverage confirms g_quark_to_string is executed identically in both builds.

notes: Patch changes a compiler annotation in public header glib/gquark.h (line 49). The declaration is not executable; coverage measured via compiled g_quark_to_string() in gquark.c showing 88.31% coverage from error+dataset tests
g_quark_to_string gcov hits: before=6654 after=4857 (random seed variation)
gquark.c overall coverage: 88.31% in both builds
No behavioral differences detected between before and after builds

conclusion.rationale: The patch changes g_quark_to_string() compiler annotation from G_GNUC_CONST to G_GNUC_PURE. This is a correctness fix — the function reads the global quark table so 'const' was incorrect. Testing confirms: all 4 test suites (81 subtests total) pass identically before and after; g_quark_to_string() is exercised in both builds (88.31% gquark.c coverage); no behavioral or output differences detected; coverage data shows identical execution patterns. The annotation change only affects compiler optimization decisions at call sites, not runtime function behavior.
recommended_actions: Low-risk annotation fix. No further action required.
Monitor for performance regression reports if users recompile at -O2 or higher.
